controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from its measured spectrum; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of the star's measured spectrum (Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 834). The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 9,205 K and log g 3.96 (u1 0.262, u2 0.321): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
